summary: Most IO rows have strong line/equipment associations and correct IO/signal/system fields. However, several hardwired safety and shutdown devices lack line or equipment tags and supporting geometry evidence, which is a high-impact EPC compliance gap. XYRA should improve line/equipment association for all hardwired IO, especially for SSV/PSAL types, and ensure evidence is captured or flagged for manual review.

comments.issue: Hardwired safety DI (PSAL) has no connected line or equipment tag and no geometry evidence.
comments.reason: All hardwired safety IO must be traceable to a process line or equipment for EPC handover and loop integrity.
comments.evidence_needed: PID drawing or geometry evidence showing line/equipment association for PSAL-1762P-25.

comments.issue: Shutdown valve (SSV) DO has no connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only links to another SSV, not a process line.
comments.reason: Shutdown valves must be associated with a process line or equipment for traceability and cause/effect validation.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence showing line/equipment for SSV-1414P-02.

comments.issue: Shutdown valve (SSV) DO has no connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only links to another SSV.
comments.reason: All hardwired final elements must be traceable to a process line or equipment for EPC compliance.

comments.issue: Shutdown valve (SSV) DO has no connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only links to another SSV.
comments.reason: Traceability to process line/equipment is required for all hardwired shutdown valves.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence showing line/equipment for SSV-1762P-08.

comments.issue: Hardwired vibration AI has no connected line tag; geometry evidence links to equipment (motor) but not to a process line.
comments.reason: For field devices, at least equipment association is required, but line tag is preferred if the device is on a process line.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence confirming if VENT-5000-IN is line-mounted or equipment-mounted.
